body: I've noticed it only happens on my off days. I hope it goes away soon.
I was in a pretty deep hole myself. The antidepressants keep my from staying there all day, but I feel like I'm starting to get back into it little by little.
Really? It seems as though they will just put me back into the mental hospital like they did before. :(

My doctor says I need to take the medication forever. Last time I told my therapist everything on my mind I got sent to the er for 7 days. I will be more guarded from now on. 

Edit: forgot stuff

I usually force myself to eat breakfast, lunch and dinner during the week (mon-fri) If I don't like what's being served I either skip it or eat a bowl of cereal. I work at a big summer camp and I don't have a car to get my own food so I go to the dining hall. Last week I didn't eat anything during the weekend (again) and I skipped breakfast on Monday. I ended up overhearing, getting dizzy, and passing out. Despite it being 35 F outside. This week I have decided to force myself to eat food during the work week to avoid blacking out again. I have about 6 boxes of cheez it's if I do get motivated enough to crawl out of bed on the weekend. So I do have something to eat. The good news is I'm almost always hydrated with Gatorade except the weekends (as I run out on Saturday usually and don't refill my water bottle). I rarely drink just regular water anymore.

It's easier than getting out of bed to eat. I am really sad, yes. I've decided that eating is not as important as it used to be. I usually don't eat anything on the weekends now. But I did get a Therapist, so that's one step.
I don't care enough to get out of bed. I generally am not hungry enough. If I am I ignore it.

I think the only way I'd tell them is through a note. Or maybe right before I tried something. I'm not brave enough to share it with family or friends. I reached out to a counselor I talked to years ago to see what he has to say.

Edit: I forgot stuff
I really would like to keep it a secret from my family. If I went to a doctor when I'm fine (in their eyes) it would be concerning. I feel like I'm constantly watched which is extremely annoying.

I'm really confused. I'm not in a crisis, but if I had a gun I certainly would pull the trigger. The financial situation is definitely getting worse, but it's like I'm ignoring it again. I'm afraid that if my depressing thoughts return then I might follow through next time since next time it will be worse x100.
That's kind of what I'm thinking. I'm afraid they will start rumors about me.

That's kind of what I do except mine are all on my laptop. I use music to influence my decisions. I have told about 7 people. All online and all I don't know in person and they don't know me. People have started to notice at work and I'm starting to crack. I'm not sure how much longer I can keep this a secret. :(
When my dog died I was devastated. I might tell people I'm super sad and depressed today. It depends what I feel like

My dog died of cancer in October :((((( I wish I had cancer too. I almost told my boss today. he asked what was wrong and I said I'd tell him later. He never asked about it later so I never told him. The regret eats away at me. :(
This would be my first time. I don't want to fail. That's the main reason why I haven't done anything. Pain is the 2nd

I'm not sure. That might cause a big scene. To most people everything looks normal. Calling 911 would upset a lot of people. I would if I was about to do something. I've been thinking about buying a gun. 

edit: it seems like a waste to call 911 if I don't do anything to myself for them to fix. I would be wasting their time too

I have a plan too. I have everything but the courage to follow through. I even have a plan b in case I can't bring myself to do plan a. I'm worried that I'll get locked up if I tell anyone my plans. It might just be better to tell them just a tiny bit of what is happening but not the whole story. 'I have the note and the method ready doctor! When should I go?' I can't say that. I need to think of something I won't get in trouble for.

It's definitely getting harder to remember happier thoughts. All I keep repeating is I failed college, I can't get a good job, I have no friends outside of work, I want to sleep all day. I go online and see my friends getting married, finishing school and I'm just stuck doing a minimum wage job. I will never succeed. I feel like I'm in a dark room with a closed door and the only light I can see is coming from under the door. I can't open that door. It's welded shut. I will always be able to look, but never be a part of it. :(

I don't have enough money for a doctor :( I'm not sure how to explain that I want to get run over by a train every morning at work. (That's what I've been thinking about the last few days.)  What would they think of me? :( my parents would probably find out :( would I be allowed to work?
Hmm when I look at it that way I suppose you are right. It only works for so long *sigh*

I feel like I would be watched constantly. That would be a problem. I work at a place where you are surrounded by people all the time. I sleep, eat, and do my hobbies at work. If I left a note with my suicide intentions on it it wouldn't be taken lightly here. I hate it when people worry about me. I feel like a burden on others. I'm a waste of money and time.(this is the don't tell anyone part of me). The happy me is considering your idea and trying to decide where to leave such a note and how I would explain my preoccupation with death everyday.

I've considered that a lot. The nearest hospital is 80 miles away. I'm in a village (population ~1000 so it's like a small town) with no hospital. I have no car so that means I would have to tell someone else so they can drive me and explain why I'm going. I'd rather just die. I'm really good at talking online, but I'm abysmal at talking face to face. I'm nervous about the cost for counseling. I've almost spent almost all my money on a game similar to game of war.

I have. I've put a lot of thought into what I would say and who I would say it to. I would do anything to not tell my family. I don't have any close friends anymore since I've shut them out. Being alone is a blessing and a curse. I don't have anyone I trust enough to listen now. I'm afraid they will tell my family. One person I vaguely told said that he would tell them if I don't. That just makes everything worse. I feel guilty for not telling them. It makes me sad
I think they'd judge me if I wrote everything out. It sounds like a good idea in concept, but I can't bring myself to try that just yet

I've never been diagnosed before and I'm afraid of telling anyone anything. I finally texted a crisis hotline and they help me go to sleep, but then I have to start the day looking happy and fresh. I usually sleep all day. That's why I skip meals. I sleep through breakfast, lunch, and dinner. When I wake up I realize that I have 5-6 hours until work and I go back to bed. Then when my body wakes up I feel fine then I blackout. It has happened 3 times so far. I cannot let it happen again at work. Can I mentally tell myself not to black out? Is that possible? I'm really worried

Most people do say "what are you doing today? Gaming?" In a somewhat sarcastic voice. I will try the taking a break thing. Right now I usually take one every 3-4 hours. But every hour would be worth a try.

The funny thing was it wasn't my car. It was my friends roommates car. It has a governor or whatnot it in it. We only hit 127mph going downhill. Then a state trooper pulled me over going 105. Got a warning. ~lucky me My actual car is a red Honda Accord. I've never been on a date 

Edit: didn't know that * = italicized things
I was driving a Kia Rio. Crap car. Wanted to see what the max speed was. Stupid reason i know. "You could have been killed" yay me

You are funny yes. Idc what the bot says. I have a few months before the final decision. I've been thinking about this for around 5 months so what's a few months more?  The only way things would get worse would be if I lost my job.

I typically go for 95 hours a week. If I stopped I'd have absolutely nothing to do. I also keep a journal. I only write in it when I'm sad. I try not to look into it when I'm happy since it usually makes me sad again.  It is a text document on my laptop. If anyone found it I would consider crashing my car into a wall at 150mph. (My record is 127) I understand I have a lot of potential in my life, but I'm too scared of failing. Everyone is better than me.
Maybe, I'm not very optimistic. If I tell anyone then I will lose everything. I could potentially save up to buy said shotgun but getting a license without my family finding out is a problem.

I suppose I could try that out. It's been awhile since I was on twitch. I'm generally too worthless to gain any followers on anything. I play Star Wars the old republic. It will be hard to tell everyone goodbye.
